svg.aria-label: CIFAR-100 prototypes: real initialization images, the same prototypes after 8,000 MIPA iterations, and noise-initialized prototypes
svg.title: CIFAR-100 prototypes: real initialization images, the same prototypes after 8,000 MIPA iterations, and noise-initialized prototypes
svg.text: CIFAR-100, 1% budget. MIPA starts from real images and optimizes pixels directly (images shown without enhancement).
Starting from Gaussian noise yields geometric patterns and local texture, but little recognizable object structure.
